s.note: Cold king prawns with lemon aioli and buttered white bread.
s.how: Beat 150g mayonnaise with 2 crushed garlic cloves, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Pile 1.2kg cooked king prawns on a platter over ice with lemon wedges, and serve with the aioli and 8 slices of buttered white bread. Peel as you go.

s.note: Garlic and chilli squid grilled hot and fast, finished with lime and coriander
s.how: Score 600g cleaned squid tubes and cut into pieces. Toss with oil, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli and salt. Grill on a very hot barbecue for 1 minute a side and finish with lime juice and coriander.

m.n: Dampier sausages, steak and potato salad
m.note: Charcoal beef sausages and rump steak, fried onions, mayo potato salad, white bread
m.how: Boil 1kg potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and 4 rump steaks over hot coals. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate until golden. Serve it all with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.

w.n: Mine canteen jam roly-poly and custard
w.note: Jam rolled in soft pastry, baked and sliced, with hot custard.
w.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 250g self-raising flour, mix in 1 tbsp sugar and about 120ml milk to a soft dough, and roll to a 25 x 30cm rectangle. Spread with 150g raspberry jam leaving a 2cm edge, roll up and wrap loosely in baking paper and foil. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Heat 500ml milk with 2 tbsp custard powder and 3 tbsp sugar, whisking until thick, and pour over thick slices.

d.note: Lager topped with fresh ruby grapefruit soda over ice, soda only for drivers
d.how: Juice 2 ruby grapefruits and stir with 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then mix with 400ml cold soda water. Chill well. Half fill 4 tall glasses or stubby holder cups with cold lager, top with the grapefruit soda and add a grapefruit wedge. Serve the grapefruit soda on its own for the drivers.
